description: Synthesize speech for an avatar session and return a base64 audio data URL the client can play. Free NVIDIA NIM Magpie TTS leads when NVIDIA_API_KEY is set (non-pcm requests are served as WAV); OpenAI TTS is the paid backstop when OPENAI_API_KEY is set. Picks the session's configured voice unless overridden.

format.description: Audio format (default mp3; the free NVIDIA lane serves every non-pcm request as wav).

language.description: BCP-47 language for the free NVIDIA lane (en-US default; also es-US, fr-FR, de-DE, zh-CN, vi-VN, it-IT, hi-IN, ja-JP).

model.description: OpenAI TTS model used on the paid backstop lane (default gpt-4o-mini-tts). The free NVIDIA lane always serves magpie-tts-multilingual.

sessionId.description: Avatar session id (optional — when omitted, voice falls back to the override or "nova").

voice.description: Override the session voice for this call.

name: speak
title: Avatar speaks (TTS)
